notes.title: Garten of Banban's socials, updates and future!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!
We are very happy to see that Garten of Banban has gained a lot of interest. If you would to stay up to the date with this series or any future updates then check out our social media links:

Twitter (For all the news and updates):
https://twitter.com/Euphoric_Bros

Youtube (For all the trailers and potentially development/behind the scenes videos or devlogs):
https://www.youtube.com/@EuphoricBrothers

Tiktok (For short videos about our games):
https://www.tiktok.com/@euphoricbros

If you enjoyed Garten of Banban, then also check out Garten of Banban 2 and add it to your wishlist!

That's it, thanks again for being here!
- Ghepo & Faris, Euphoric Brothers
